_comment: hardest constraint, verbatim: 'ENFORCE stays OFF until every §5 signature
exists — no exception, no partial ignition.' Until 2026-08-25 that rule
lived only in prose: a single env flip (VISA_ENGINE_EVALUATE_MODE=ENFORCE)
would have made the engine the product authority with zero signatures.
This file is what `evaluate_path.resolve_evaluate_mode()` reads to refuse.
It is build-time data, not runtime state: a signature is a deliberate,
reviewable, committed act by the owner. Flipping one here without the
owner's actual decision is falsifying a consent record — do not.
Zero (and only Zero) turns a `signed` to true, in a commit that also
records where the decision was given.
